name: androidx.core.content.FileProvider
description: AndroidX Core provides a private file-sharing component that turns files from configured folders into temporary links other apps can access. Android starts it with the app; it is used when the app shares a file or hands a photo or video to another app, and it has no screen of its own.
disableEffect: Disabling it can make file sharing, exports, photo or video handoffs, and camera capture fail when an app relies on it to give another app access to a file.
